new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, AI Infrastructure and Capacity Operations
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead recurring capacity operations for large-scale AI infrastructure programs and support tooling and automation initiatives! You will build the mechanisms that keep demand, supply, readiness, risks, decisions, and delivery work visible, sequenced, detailed, and moving.

This is an operational leadership role, not a meeting-coordination role. You will challenge incomplete inputs, establish operating cadences, turn ambiguous constraints into clear decisions, and close cross-functional actions - partnering with, not replacing, technical owners.

What You Will Be Doing

Own intake, triage, routing and request-quality standards for accelerator-capacity requests across multiple engineering and research teams.
Run quarterly and annual demand forecasts, change control, review preparation, and follow-through; identify late, incomplete, or conflicting inputs early.
Prepare capacity-planning and allocation reviews using demand, available supply, prior commitments, readiness, workload timing, and business priorities.
Track capacity through its operational lifecycle—from request and forecast through delivery, readiness, assignment, and productive use.
Coordinate infrastructure dependencies such as access, storage, data movement, networking, readiness checks, migration timing, and provider or provisioning tickets.
Maintain dashboards and source-data quality, including freshness checks, ownership for missing inputs, reconciliation, and retirement of repeated manual reporting.
Own operating cadences, agendas, action logs, dependency tracking, decision records, risk registers, blocking issue paths, and closure difficulty.
Prepare concise leadership reporting that distinguishes facts, risks, decisions needed, options, recommended paths, accountable owners, and due dates.

What We Need To See

BS/MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or similar (or equivalent experience).
7+ years of technical program management or closely related experience in AI/ML platforms, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, compute capacity, or another technically demanding engineering environment.
Shown ownership of recurring operational programs with scarce-resource trade-offs, multiple cadences, executive clarity, and overlapping peak periods.
Strong program mechanics: intake compose, forecasting, review preparation, dependency management, decision and risk records, action closure, documentation, and status communication.
Enough technical proficiency to understand infrastructure constraints, ask detailed questions, inspect requirements and metrics, and work credibly with engineers and researchers.
Data proficiency sufficient to evaluate source quality, interpret dashboards, reconcile conflicting views, define useful operational measures, and identify missing ownership.
Consistent track record to transform ambiguous cross-functional work into a durable operating system with clear owners, decisions, and critical issue paths with excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn sophisticated updates into concise decisions, risks, options, actions, and leadership mentorship.
Ability to influence without authority across research, platform engineering, infrastructure, data, finance, operations, and leadership collaborators!

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience with GPU or other accelerator-capacity planning, utilization programs, cluster operations, workload bring-up, or large-scale AI training and inference environments.
Experience with demand and supply roadmaps, normalization across accelerator types, allocation reviews, quota or priority management, and capacity migrations.
Familiarity with batch scheduling, cluster-management, cloud, or data-center environments and the operational dependencies that affect workload readiness.
Experience with observability or dashboard platforms, data-quality controls, and automated reporting for infrastructure or service operations.
Experience driving API-enabled workflow automation or decision-support tools with explicit human approval gates, audit evidence, and safe operating controls.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 258,750 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 22, 2026.

new_jobs.title: IS Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
As a member of the Information Services Department, the IS Project Manager will manage and execute technology projects to improve business results and client experience. The IS Project Manager is responsible for coordinating across the overall program, scope, risk and schedule management and troubleshooting.

Essential Functions

Work with business teams to complete project intake, define project scope and objectives, timelines, budgets, and deliverables.
Manage projects, develop project plans, allocate resources, and monitor performance deliverables to ensure timely completion of projects.
Participate in requirements gathering meetings in a way to ensure the end solution meets the requestors “needs” versus “wants”.
Effectively communicate your project plans to cross-functional team members and management.
Coordinate resources and timetables with business departments and IS teams.
Gather critical information from meetings with various stakeholders to make necessary project adjustments and produce useful visuals and reports when necessary.
Partner with business teams to create User Acceptance Test plans and serve as a liaison between technical and business teams when conducting the testing.
Identify and resolve issues in project plans and schedules.
Communicate project status consistently (weekly/bi-weekly as appropriate) with project team and stakeholders enabling informed decision-making.
Report and escalate issues to management as needed.
Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation.
Manage multiple projects at once.

Additional Functions

Special Projects, as assigned.

Education

QUALIFICATIONS (EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES):

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration or related discipline required. Equivalent combination of education, training and experience in lieu of degree may be considered.

Experience

5 years of IT industry experience
5 years of project management experience

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Excellent analytical, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent project management and organization skills.
Strong leadership and people skills to establish and maintain effective working relationships with peers, managers and clients.
Strong professional communication both written and verbal.
Highly organized with attention to detail and excellent follow-through skills.
Experience with both agile and waterfall project management methodologies.
Gather requirements and process mapping experience required.
Strong ability to multi-task.
Proactive, self-motivated with a high level of ownership and drive to achieve goals.
Skill to document complex systems and procedures.
In-depth knowledge of system life cycle processes.
Relevant technical, functional and/or process expertise.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.).
Ability to navigate sometimes ambiguously defined problems, developing creative solutions and delivering meaningful results.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

This job operates in a clerical, office setting. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Physical Requirements

Sedentary work: Exertion of physical strength to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects up to 10 pounds. Work involves sitting most of the time. Walking and standing is often necessary in carrying out job duties.

Compensation & Benefits

The salary ranges for this position apply to the respective listed locations. The salary range reflects a variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to experience, education, licensure and/or certifications, geographic location, market demands and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for a position. Reasonable estimates of the current ranges for this position are:

Las Vegas: $110,000 - $125,000
Atlantic City, Chicago, Minneapolis: $120,000 - $145,000
Boston, Denver, Los Angeles, Morristown, Princeton, Seattle, Washington D.C.: $135,000 - $150,000
New York, San Francisco: $155,000 - $170,000

For information on Fox Rothschild's compensation and benefits visit: Compensation & Benefits (foxrothschild.com)

new_jobs.title: Senior Design Program Manager, On Air
new_jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

About The Role

The Netflix XD Operations team is seeking a Design Program Manager to join our XD Team within our Live On Air Creative division. You will establish and optimize the projects, processes, and pipelines for all visual touchpoints across our premium live broadcasts. This is a role for a heavy hitter who can drive complex projects from early concept to on-site execution under the high-pressure demands of live events.

You will partner with creative leads, tech teams, cross functional partners, and external production vendors to ensure our live presentation sets the gold standard for sports and entertainment.

Travel Requirement:
Monthly travel required both US national and international including holiday travel due to live + events that occur year round.

Orchestrate Live Operations: Drive the organization, resourcing, and prioritization for premium live event graphics packages and studio design systems.
Master the Timeline: Map out and manage complex, concurrent production schedules for multiple major events without breaking a sweat.
Manage the Books: Handle line-item project producing, tracking creative deliverables at the artist level while managing technology and production budgets.
Bridge Design and Tech: Establish clear workflows for technical playout requirements, ensuring assets function flawlessly in real-time broadcast environments.
Own the Truck Environment: Lead on-site graphics integration from remote production trucks, managing real-time changes and troubleshooting under live-to-air pressure.
Build Trusted Partnerships: Act as the primary operational liaison for internal cross-functional teams, external vendors, and executive stakeholders.
Protect the Creative: Safeguard the design process by giving artists the time, space, and clear parameters needed to build elite visual packages.

Description Of Background

The biggest live stages do not rattle you, and the most ambitious deliveries are just another Tuesday. You have deep technical knowledge of how broadcast graphics sit, breathe, and play out in real-time, remote environments. You can speak fluent artist, fluent engineer, and fluent executive all in the same meeting.

Scale and Presence: You have spent a decade guiding high-end productions and know how to keep a steady hand when millions of eyes are watching.
Broadcast Fluent: You are deeply familiar with the unique constraints, terminology, and workflows of live remote trucks and studio control rooms.
Fiscal and Operational Muscle: You have a proven track record of managing complex creative budgets, vendor contracts, and resource allocations.
On-Site Agility: You are comfortable traveling to events, managing on-site production personnel, and communicating clearly across all levels of a live crew.

Industry Experience & Must-Haves

10+ years of experience overseeing creative production teams and partnering with design leadership in high-profile live sports or entertainment environments.
Deep operational knowledge of traditional sports broadcasting, studio environments, and real-time graphics playout platforms.
Proven track record managing tech pipelines, budgets, and contractual relationships with premium external partners.
Global perspective with experience executing major live events both domestically and internationally.
Expert communication skills with the ability to navigate matrixed corporate structures and deliver crisp updates to premium stakeholders.
An ego-free approach to leadership, meaning you welcome candid feedback, learn quickly from misses, and focus entirely on the success of the team.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $260,000.00 - $370,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Location
: Hybrid, New York

Medidata follows a hybrid office policy in which employees who are hired for an in-person position are expected to work on site a certain number of days per week following Company policy.

About our Company
:

Medidata is powering smarter treatments and healthier people through digital solutions to support clinical trials. Celebrating over 25 years of ground-breaking technological innovation across more than 38,000 trials and 12 million patients, Medidata offers industry-leading expertise, analytics-powered insights, and one of the largest clinical trial data sets in the industry. More than 1 million registered users across approximately 2,300 customers trust Medidata's seamless, end-to-end platform to improve patient experiences, accelerate clinical breakthroughs, and bring therapies to market faster. A Dassault Systèmes brand (Euronext Paris: FR0014003TT8, DSY.PA), Medidata is headquartered in New York City and has been recognized as a Leader by Everest Group and IDC. Discover more at www.medidata.com. Listen to our latest podcast, from Dreamers to Disruptors, and follow us at @Medidata.

About the Team
:

We are seeking a dynamic Project Manager to lead successful project initiatives that create lasting improvements in patient and site experiences and internal engagement efforts.

Reporting to the VP, Research Site Engagement, this role is ideal for an individual with a strong foundation in project management and relationship building. The Project Manager is responsible for the overall relationship management of projects and day-to-day activities. The function also ensures that Medidata is able to deliver patient, site, and employee insights projects and services on time and within budget through effective management of Medidata resources. This role requires a strategic thinker capable of operationalizing our "Insights - as- a - Product" model.

Responsibilities:

Utilize and Oversee Project Management software solutions (WRIKE) to organize and execute plans and projects that drive internal and external engagement around patient, sites, and employee insights.
Operational Architecture: Drive the creation, development, and standardization of Wrike blueprints and automated dashboards to provide real-time visibility into program delivery, KPIs and program health.
Strategic & Custom Project Management: Lead the end-to-end lifecycle for complex, cross-functional strategic projects. This includes developing custom project plans for both internal mission-alignment efforts and client-facing engagements.
Data-Driven Operational Excellence: Implement rigorous project documentation standards that support the commercialization of OSIE insights, ensuring deliverables are "audit-ready" and consistent with our global OSIE model
Lead project delivery to ensure that all deliverables are tracked and that documentation is current
Manage project expectations and communications, and ensure overall satisfaction
Strategic Reporting: Act as the operational pulse for OSIE leadership, ensuring that project tracking, forecasting, and budgeting directly support our goals, ensuring onetime delivery and superior customer satisfaction.
Manage project financials including forecasting, project budget, and accuracy of invoicing
Create and maintain accurate and current project documentation
Raise and track work requests with other departments as needed
Document minutes/action items during all project team meetings; conduct appropriate follow-up as necessary
Manage issues and risks driving appropriate resolution and mitigation
Provide proactive communication to all stakeholders
Assure compliance with Medidata's standard project management methodologies, quality management system
Support development of sales orders and change orders
Deliver workshops and lead client meetings
Insights Delivery: Partner with leadership to transform raw patient, site, and employee feedback into high-value, AI-assisted data assets. Ensure every project initiative contributes to our centralized intelligence database.

Your Competencies:

Requires only general instruction for routine assignments, and some coaching/mentoring on more complex assignments
Preference for a basic understanding of clinical research (pharma/device/biotech) and of clinical research SaaS technology
Demonstrate good verbal/written communication and organizational skills
Exhibit time management skills along with strong collaboration and teamwork
Experience in leading project teams and meeting project timelines
Self-motivated and able to assume responsibility in a professional manner
Experience with creating and delivering presentations
Operational Mindset: Demonstrated ability to build and maintain sophisticated project management infrastructure (e.g., Wrike, Asana, or similar) to scale operations and ensure global replicability.
Analytical Aptitude: Ability to translate qualitative human experiences (patient/site/employee feedback) into quantitative metrics and actionable data assets.
Strategic Agility: Experience managing both internal engagement programs and external client-facing projects with a focus on commercial value and ROI

Qualifications:

4-year college degree or equivalent (analytic discipline a plus) preferred
Minimum of 2 years experience in clinical/biomedical and/ or software development environment preferred
3-5 years of experience in project management, operations, or business intelligence, preferably within a high-growth environment, clinical research organization (CRO), or software/tech sector.
Project Management Foundation: Demonstrated experience building or optimizing operational workflows. Proven ability to move functions to scale by developing SOPs, RACI matrices, and standard intake frameworks
Analytical Rigor: A background in an analytical discipline is required. Must demonstrate experience in transforming raw, qualitative feedback (e.g., patient, site, or employee data) into high-value, commercialized data assets or strategic reports
Familiarity with AI-driven synthesis tools (e.g., NotebookLM) and project management platforms (e.g., Wrike)

Come Join ReSource Pro!

Your Role...

ReSource Pro is seeking a Data Governance and Stewardship Lead establishes and maintains the frameworks, standards, and practices that support the integrity, security, compliance, and appropriate use of ReSource Pro’s data. The role translates data governance principles into practical policies, controls, stewardship practices, and data quality standards that can be consistently applied across a complex, data-intensive environment.

The role works cross-functionally with Data Strategy, Technology, Security, Legal, Compliance, and business stakeholders to define and maintain governance standards for how data is collected, classified, accessed, used, retained, and retired. The Data Governance and Stewardship Lead also supports data quality, lineage, documentation, and stewardship practices that enable the effective use of data for analytics, reporting, automation, and AI.

The role applies strategic and hands-on expertise to establish and maintain data governance practices, translate complex governance requirements into practical policies and guidance, and support consistent adoption and accountability across the organization.

All remote positions are based in the United States, and candidates must reside within the U.S. to be eligible for consideration.

In this role, you will...

Build and Maintain the Data Governance and Stewardship Framework

Develop, document, and maintain data governance policies, standards, procedures, and controls that support the appropriate collection, classification, storage, access, use, retention, and retirement of data.

Define and maintain data ownership, accountability, stewardship, and quality responsibilities across business and functional areas.

Establish practical and scalable governance practices that can be consistently applied across a complex, data-intensive organization.

Maintain clear documentation of governance requirements, decision rights, standards, and operating practices.

Partner with data owners, stewards, and cross-functional stakeholders to implement governance standards and resolve data-related issues.

Develop guidance and education that help stakeholders understand and fulfill their data governance and stewardship responsibilities.

Drive Data Quality, Lineage, and Data Lifecycle Management

Define and maintain data quality standards, rules, and processes for critical data assets.

Establish monitoring and control mechanisms to identify data errors, gaps, inconsistencies, and other quality issues.

Partner with data owners and stewards to investigate root causes, prioritize remediation, and improve data quality over time.

Maintain data lineage and documentation to improve traceability from source systems through downstream use.

Support the development and maintenance of data catalogs, business glossaries, metadata, and other documentation that improve understanding and accessibility of governed data.

Help ensure data assets can be traced, understood, and appropriately governed throughout their lifecycle.

Monitor adherence to established data governance and quality standards and communicate findings, risks, and remediation needs to relevant stakeholders.

Support Data Privacy, Security, Client Commitments, and Responsible Data Use

Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders to support data privacy, security, risk management, and regulatory requirements.

Translate contractual and client-specific data requirements into clear governance standards, controls, and operating practices.

Support governance of how client and company data may be accessed, used, stored, shared, retained, and retired.

Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence to demonstrate adherence to applicable data requirements and commitments.

Identify and escalate governance risks, gaps, and potential areas of non-compliance.

Partner with analytics, technology, and AI teams to ensure data used for automation, analytics, and AI applications meets applicable governance, privacy, security, quality, and documentation requirements.

Support governance practices that promote responsible and explainable use of data in AI-enabled solutions.

Monitor Adoption and Continuously Improve Governance Practices

Develop metrics, reporting, and other mechanisms to monitor governance adoption, data quality, and areas of risk or improvement.

Track adherence to data governance standards and support remediation where practices fall short.

Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on data governance and stewardship questions.

Promote data literacy and effective stewardship practices through clear documentation, training, and engagement.

Facilitate collaboration among data owners, stewards, and technical teams to resolve governance and data quality issues.

Continuously refine governance practices as regulations, client requirements, business needs, and technology evolve.

Teamwork & Collaboration (Standard)

Foster a respectful and collaborative environment by upholding professionalism and engaging in constructive and respectful conversations.

Support a positive workplace culture by promoting open, solution-oriented communication, encouraging teamwork, and maintaining a focus on shared goals and productivity.

What You Need to be Successful...

Educational Background:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

Working Experience Required And Preferred

5–8 years of experience in data governance, data stewardship, data management, data quality, or a related discipline.

Experience Working In The Insurance Industry Preferred.

Experience supporting data governance for analytics, automation, machine learning, or AI use cases.

Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data management best practices, or relevant industry standards.

Experience implementing or improving data governance programs in a growing or changing organization.

Behavioral/technical skills; Competencies

Hands-on experience developing, implementing, or maintaining data governance frameworks, policies, standards, and controls.

Experience establishing practices related to data quality, classification, access, retention, privacy, or lifecycle management.

Working knowledge of data privacy, security, regulatory, and compliance requirements in a regulated or data-intensive environment.

Experience with data catalogs, metadata management, data lineage, data quality tools, or related data management technologies.

Strong data fluency, including the ability to understand data structures, relationships, sources, and downstream use; experience with SQL is preferred.

Ability to translate complex governance, privacy, security, and data management requirements into clear policies and practical guidance.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and drive sustainable remediation.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to documentation, process, and follow-through.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and influence stakeholders across functions without direct authority.

Technological proficiency – able to learn, utilize, and navigate a variety of external and internal systems

5% travel: Domestic for company meetings, global every 1-2 years

new_jobs.description:
About The Team

The Corporate Security team ensures the physical safety and security of the organization's assets, operations, and personnel. We are committed to maintaining a secure environment that enables our team to focus on advancing artificial intelligence in a responsible manner.

About The Role

As a Protective Intelligence & Threat Analyst, you will identify, assess, and communicate physical security threats affecting OpenAI, its personnel, executives, operations, and assets. You will leverage open-source intelligence, social media, investigative tools, and other information sources to assess violent or disruptive threats, geopolitical developments, and emerging risks relevant to the company.

The role will support a broad range of Protective Intelligence activities, including persons of interest investigations, behavioral threat assessment, executive and individual risk assessments, event and travel security assessments, and time-sensitive intelligence support to Corporate Security and cross-functional partners. You will turn complex and often incomplete information into clear assessments and actionable recommendations that help inform security and protective decisions.

We are seeking candidates with intelligence experience, particularly in protective intelligence, threat investigations, or behavioral threat assessment. Successful candidates will understand the intelligence cycle, OSINT investigative techniques, corporate physical security, risk management, and threat assessment, and will be comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment involving sensitive and occasionally high-profile matters.

This role could be based in San Francisco, CA, or may be a remote role for the right candidate. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. Relocation offered for those outside of the Bay Area.

In This Role, You Will

Identify and investigate potential physical threats to OpenAI, its executives, employees, facilities, operations, and other assets using OSINT, investigative tools, and structured analytical techniques.
Conduct persons of interest (POI) and behavioral threat investigations to evaluate the credibility, intent, capability, and potential severity of identified threats and provide appropriate risk mitigation recommendations.
Conduct individual risk assessments and develop concise intelligence products and briefings that help Corporate Security and protective teams understand the evolving threat environment surrounding executives and other at-risk personnel.
Assess threats and security considerations associated with executive travel, company events, public appearances, meetings, and other activities requiring heightened protective awareness.
Provide timely intelligence support to Executive Protection and other Corporate Security partners, translating complex or rapidly evolving information into actionable protective recommendations.
Research and assess geopolitical, social, activist, and other emerging developments that may create physical security risks to OpenAI personnel, operations, infrastructure, or events.
Prepare and disseminate clear, decision-oriented intelligence assessments, threat briefings, and other products for senior leaders, protective teams, and relevant stakeholders.
Analyze and manage OSINT data collections in ways that improve discoverability, retrievability, analysis, and appropriate dissemination.
Leverage advanced analytical tools, automation, and emerging technologies to improve threat detection, investigations, assessments, and the broader intelligence cycle.
Maintain and improve methodologies, protocols, and procedures for protective intelligence collection, analysis, assessment, and dissemination.
Develop strong intelligence-sharing and working relationships across Corporate Security and with relevant internal and external partners.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You Have

5+ years of relevant experience in protective intelligence, threat investigations, intelligence analysis, behavioral threat assessment, executive protection intelligence, or a related field.
Strong judgment and the ability to assess incomplete or ambiguous information, distinguish signal from noise, and communicate risk with appropriate context and confidence.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize information from multiple sources into concise, actionable intelligence products for audiences ranging from protective operators to technical stakeholders and senior leaders.
Experience assessing risks involving executives, high-profile individuals, events, travel, or other environments requiring time-sensitive security decision-making.
Technical proficiency or demonstrated interest in using APIs, automation, Python, data platforms, AI-enabled tools, and other technologies to improve intelligence collection, analysis, and threat detection.
The ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively within a small, dynamic, globally distributed team and across Communications, Government Relations, People, Legal, Information Security, Executive Protection, and other partners.
Familiarity with protective intelligence and threat management platforms such as Ontic and with structured behavioral threat assessment methodologies such as those used by ATAP.
Comfort supporting time-sensitive security matters, including occasional nights or weekends during significant incidents, events, travel, or crises.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

new_jobs.title: Protective Intelligence & Threat Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About The Team

The Corporate Security team ensures the physical safety and security of the organization's assets, operations, and personnel. We are committed to maintaining a secure environment that enables our team to focus on advancing artificial intelligence in a responsible manner.

About The Role

As a Protective Intelligence & Threat Analyst, you will identify, assess, and communicate physical security threats affecting OpenAI, its personnel, executives, operations, and assets. You will leverage open-source intelligence, social media, investigative tools, and other information sources to assess violent or disruptive threats, geopolitical developments, and emerging risks relevant to the company.

The role will support a broad range of Protective Intelligence activities, including persons of interest investigations, behavioral threat assessment, executive and individual risk assessments, event and travel security assessments, and time-sensitive intelligence support to Corporate Security and cross-functional partners. You will turn complex and often incomplete information into clear assessments and actionable recommendations that help inform security and protective decisions.

We are seeking candidates with intelligence experience, particularly in protective intelligence, threat investigations, or behavioral threat assessment. Successful candidates will understand the intelligence cycle, OSINT investigative techniques, corporate physical security, risk management, and threat assessment, and will be comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment involving sensitive and occasionally high-profile matters.

This role could be based in San Francisco, CA, or may be a remote role for the right candidate. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. Relocation offered for those outside of the Bay Area.

In This Role, You Will

Identify and investigate potential physical threats to OpenAI, its executives, employees, facilities, operations, and other assets using OSINT, investigative tools, and structured analytical techniques.
Conduct persons of interest (POI) and behavioral threat investigations to evaluate the credibility, intent, capability, and potential severity of identified threats and provide appropriate risk mitigation recommendations.
Conduct individual risk assessments and develop concise intelligence products and briefings that help Corporate Security and protective teams understand the evolving threat environment surrounding executives and other at-risk personnel.
Assess threats and security considerations associated with executive travel, company events, public appearances, meetings, and other activities requiring heightened protective awareness.
Provide timely intelligence support to Executive Protection and other Corporate Security partners, translating complex or rapidly evolving information into actionable protective recommendations.
Research and assess geopolitical, social, activist, and other emerging developments that may create physical security risks to OpenAI personnel, operations, infrastructure, or events.
Prepare and disseminate clear, decision-oriented intelligence assessments, threat briefings, and other products for senior leaders, protective teams, and relevant stakeholders.
Analyze and manage OSINT data collections in ways that improve discoverability, retrievability, analysis, and appropriate dissemination.
Leverage advanced analytical tools, automation, and emerging technologies to improve threat detection, investigations, assessments, and the broader intelligence cycle.
Maintain and improve methodologies, protocols, and procedures for protective intelligence collection, analysis, assessment, and dissemination.
Develop strong intelligence-sharing and working relationships across Corporate Security and with relevant internal and external partners.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You Have

5+ years of relevant experience in protective intelligence, threat investigations, intelligence analysis, behavioral threat assessment, executive protection intelligence, or a related field.
Strong judgment and the ability to assess incomplete or ambiguous information, distinguish signal from noise, and communicate risk with appropriate context and confidence.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize information from multiple sources into concise, actionable intelligence products for audiences ranging from protective operators to technical stakeholders and senior leaders.
Experience assessing risks involving executives, high-profile individuals, events, travel, or other environments requiring time-sensitive security decision-making.
Technical proficiency or demonstrated interest in using APIs, automation, Python, data platforms, AI-enabled tools, and other technologies to improve intelligence collection, analysis, and threat detection.
The ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively within a small, dynamic, globally distributed team and across Communications, Government Relations, People, Legal, Information Security, Executive Protection, and other partners.
Familiarity with protective intelligence and threat management platforms such as Ontic and with structured behavioral threat assessment methodologies such as those used by ATAP.
Comfort supporting time-sensitive security matters, including occasional nights or weekends during significant incidents, events, travel, or crises.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

Within the context of a shared services initiative between Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH) and Providence Health Care (PHC), the Telecommunications Specialist is responsible for planning, implementing and maintaining a complex voice communications infrastructure for designates sites including development, testing and implementation of new designs and enhancements to telecommunications systems. Performs project management duties for planned or proposed voice telecommunications upgrades, expansions and applications and performs telephone repair, moves, adds and changes. Ensures efficient operation of the voice network, provides technical and troubleshooting support and liaises with vendors for major PBX and network engineering requirements. Provides related training and orientation.

Duties/Accountabilities

Performs project management duties for planned or proposed voice telecommunications upgrades, expansions, and moves by conducting needs analysis to establish a clear understanding of departmental operational requirements, processes and work flow. Recommends technology solutions specifying hardware and software, determining installation requirements, providing time and budget estimates/benefits, coordinating project information with other IMIS team members and departments, and coordinating the installation with users and vendors.
Analyzes voice network, PBX and voicemail system reports for utilization levels to confirm that established services levels and forecasted and project-based growth requirements are met to ensure efficient operation of the voice network. Provides assessment and recommendations to Regional Manager.
Liaises with and provides direction to telecommunication suppliers in over-seeing changes to existing service, new installations, maintenance contracts, voice mail administration and service issues.
Manages communications aspects of hardware facility relocation projects and provides problem analysis and resolution on existing services and new installations.
Performs telephone repairs, moves, adds and changes, programs voicemail passwords, test software configuration changes, and provides technical and troubleshooting support related to PBX, Voicemail and paging systems utilizing dial-up modem access in order to resolve technical problems. Visits remote sites as required.
Ensures operational communications needs are met for voice systems and network shutdowns by assessing user implications, providing back up solutions and resources scheduling.
Develops, implements and maintains polices and procedures for the installation and maintenance of telecommunications services by documenting new processes and enhancements and liaising with other voice telecommunications team members across VCH.
Keeps abreast of developments in network and standard application software, identifies product upgrades, evaluates new products or enhancements and makes selection recommendations based on user requirements. Analyzes vendor changes and enhancements by assessing the impact on existing systems and suitability for new systems implementation.
Provides user orientation and training on voice telecommunications systems as required through methods such as determining training requirements, writing procedural handouts, orientating group/individuals to ensure users are informed of required applications and training is adapted to requirements of specific area.
Maintains currency in technology knowledge and skills by researching information in Web sites and trade journals, meeting with vendors and networking with outside contractors.
Provides on-call service when required by consulting by telephone or working non-normal hours to resolve problems.
Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Grade 12, completion of post-secondary telecommunications courses plus four years' recent related experience, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience. Post diploma training in a major PBX administration and reporting tool.

Knowledge & Abilities

Ability to plan, organize, problem solve and prioritize work.

Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.

Ability to deal with others effectively.

Ability to work with project management, office and design tools.

Physical ability to carry out the duties of the position.

Ability to utilize effectively related hardware and software systems.

Business Analytics Consultant

EXL (NASDAQ:EXLS) is a leading operations management and analytics company that helps businesses enhance growth and profitability in the face of relentless competition and continuous disruption. Using our proprietary, award-winning Business EXLerator Framework™, which integrates analytics, automation, benchmarking, BPO, consulting, industry best practices and technology platforms, we look deeper to help companies improve global operations, enhance data-driven insights, increase customer satisfaction, and manage risk and compliance. EXL serves the insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, utilities, travel, transportation and logistics industries. Headquartered in New York, New York, EXL has more than 24,000 professionals in locations throughout the United States, Europe, Asia (primarily India and Philippines), Latin America, Australia and South Africa.

EXL Analytics provides data-driven, action-oriented solutions to business problems through statistical data mining, cutting edge analytics techniques and a consultative approach. Leveraging proprietary methodology and best-of-breed technology, EXL Analytics takes an industry-specific approach to transform our clients’ decision making and embed analytics more deeply into their business processes. Our global footprint of nearly 2,000 data scientists and analysts assist client organizations with complex risk minimization methods, advanced marketing, pricing and CRM strategies, internal cost analysis, and cost and resource optimization within the organization. EXL Analytics serves the insurance, healthcare, banking, capital markets, utilities, retail and e-commerce, travel, transportation and logistics industries.

Please visit www.exlservice.com for more information about EXL Analytics.

Role and Responsibilities Overview

Work with the data strategy team and serve as the primary business lead for managing the end-to-end lifecycle of third-party data relationships, from intake and evaluation through renewal and governance.
Partner with business, IT, procurement, and finance stakeholders to define use cases, develop value cases, and support data acquisition decisions.
Analyze vendor usage, costs, and business value to provide recommendations on renewals, optimizations, vendor consolidation, and sourcing strategies.
Coordinate budgeting, payment processing, and cost allocation activities to ensure financial transparency and effective spend management.
Develop and maintain playbooks, operating procedures, and governance frameworks to standardize vendor and data lifecycle management processes.
Build strong stakeholder and vendor relationships while driving strategic initiatives, process improvements, and decision-ready business analysis with minimal oversight.

Candidate Profile

6–10+ years of experience in business analysis, data strategy, operations, consulting, vendor management, procurement support, or similar stakeholder-facing roles within a large enterprise environment.
Proven ability to independently manage cross-functional stakeholders and drive complex initiatives from intake through execution with minimal supervision.
Strong communication and facilitation skills with the ability to translate business needs into clear use cases, value propositions, and executive-ready recommendations.
Analytical and structured thinker with experience evaluating business value, usage trends, costs, budgets, and operational performance to support decision-making.
Experience collaborating with business, finance, procurement, legal, and technology teams to align priorities and execute governance processes.
Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships, influence decisions, and navigate complex organizational structures.
Experience supporting vendor lifecycle management, contract renewals, procurement processes, budget planning, or data governance programs is highly preferred.
Skilled in developing operating models, playbooks, standard operating procedures, and process improvement initiatives to drive consistency and efficiency.
Self-starter with a strategic mindset, strong organizational skills, and the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industry experience is preferred but not required.
Vendor management or third-party data management experience is a plus but not mandatory.
No coding, data engineering, solution architecture, or deep technical expertise required; success in this role is driven by business acumen, stakeholder management, and decision-support capabilities.
Support the Eastern Time zone

What we offer:

EXL Analytics offers an exciting, fast paced and innovative environment, which brings together a group of sharp and entrepreneurial professionals who are eager to influence business decisions. From your very first day, you get an opportunity to work closely with highly experienced, world class analytics consultants.
You can expect to learn many aspects of businesses that our clients engage in. You will also learn effective teamwork and time-management skills - key aspects for personal and professional growth
Analytics requires different skill sets at different levels within the organization. At EXL Analytics, we invest heavily in training you in all aspects of analytics as well as in leading analytical tools and techniques.
We provide guidance/ coaching to every employee through our mentoring program wherein every junior level employee is assigned a senior level professional as advisors.
Sky is the limit for our team members. The unique experiences gathered at EXL Analytics sets the stage for further growth and development in our company and beyond.
